risk_note: RV2 platform (withdraw lane took over ops' B1-31; model Claude Fable 5.1). OpenTelemetry trace export of the api / stream / worker entries to VictoriaTraces over OTLP/HTTP (02 §13; 05 B1-31; 06 Q-A9): traces are troubleshooting data only, never an input to any money decision, and exporting is fail-open. Configuration through loadConfig only: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT (http(s) URL with a host, no credentials; the error names the variable and never echoes the value), OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG (0..1, default 1), OTEL_SERVICE_NAME (default couli-<entry>); unset endpoint = no export and no instrumentation at all (admin and payout never export). startTracing (platform/tracing/otel.ts, idempotent per process): TracerProvider with a ParentBased(TraceIdRatio) sampler, AsyncLocalStorage context, a batch processor (500 ms) in front of an OTLP/HTTP exporter (1.5 s timeout) wrapped by a failure counter (one warn otel_export_failed per minute, never thrown to a request or job), the http / pg / undici instrumentations, and a propagator that adopts only a well-formed inbound x-trace-id (32 hex or UUID → the OTel trace id) and injects traceparent + x-trace-id outbound. A sanitising processor drops url.full / url.query / http.url / http.target before export; pg reports no parameter values; headers are never recorded. 02 §13 unchanged: the request id is the well-formed inbound X-Trace-Id as sent, else (tracing on) the server span's trace id as a UUID, else a random UUID (bootstrap genReqId → requestIdForTrace); the server span carries couli.trace_id and couli.entry. shutdown() flushes within 2 s, unregisters everything and never rejects; the entry stops tracing only after its own close on a signal (watchSignals afterClose), after a startup failure's cleanup, or at once with COULI_EXIT_AFTER_INIT (money r1 S1). main.<entry>.ts starts tracing before importing the entry module so the instrumentations precede the first use of http / pg / undici; runEntry's own startTracing call (idempotent) comes after the synchronous signal watchers and database handles and before the application starts. Runtime notes: the OTel packages are loaded as their CommonJS builds through createRequire (a bundler-style resolver honouring the "module" condition picks ESM builds Node cannot load); @opentelemetry/semantic-conventions, which exports only module / esnext / default, is pinned to its build/src through module.registerHooks before the SDK loads; pg is patched through the ESM loader hook limited to pg / pg-pool; http is required right after enabling so outbound node:http calls are traced at once. staging: README §8 (variables, off switch, how to find a trace); the VictoriaTraces endpoint and whether it is open are for the owner / ops to confirm (not found in the repository or the plan) — the staging acceptance is listed as pending that confirmation (orchestrator 06:47), not blocking the merge.
